items.title: Muthoot FinCorp files for ₹3,000 crore IPO to fund growth, lending
items.description: The non-banking financial company plans to use proceeds to strengthen Tier I capital, support lending and expand its digital platform

items.title: LEAP India IPO listing in focus: Can it offer double-digit gains? Check GMP
items.description: LEAP India IPO GMP today is ₹13.5 apiece. This means shares of the company are trading at ₹172.5 in the unlisted market, suggesting a listing pop of nearly 8.5 per cent.

items.title: Smaller IPOs see sharper anchor investor exits after lock-in periods: Sebi
items.description: Sebi's study of 242 mainboard IPOs found an inverse relationship between issue size and anchor exit rates, with sub-Rs 250 crore issues recording the sharpest exits

items.title: Tablespace leases 500,000 sq ft Hyderabad office space for ₹163 crore
items.description: The coworking space provider will pay Rs 163 crore in rent over five years for 506,251 sq ft in Hyderabad's Laxmi Infobahn Software Park, documents show
